title: export.csv config
description: Appears as blueprint.components[].config. Maps to mortar.export.csv. The exported columns are code in each export controller, not config.

batchSize.description: Rows read from the database per round trip. Maps to mortar.export.csv.batch-size.

neutralizeFormulas.description: Prefix cells starting with = + - @ tab or CR with an apostrophe. Maps to mortar.export.csv.neutralize-formulas.
